answer: You have 30 days from the date of discharge to submit a standard reimbursement claim [1][2]. However, for Aurora Group Health corporate plans, the submission window is 60 days from discharge [5]. Archived 2024 rules previously specified a 15-day deadline from the date of discharge [3].
The room rent limit on the Silver plan is 2% of the sum insured per day [3][4].
No, maternity is not covered on the Bronze plan at any sum insured [1][2].

For retail plans, the waiting period for pre-existing diseases is 36 months, unless Aurora explicitly waives it in writing on the policy schedule [3][5]. Under the Aurora Senior Care plan for ages 60 and above, the waiting period for pre-existing diseases is 24 months [5].
The grace period for an annual policy is 30 days from the renewal due date [1][5].
Aurora's network covers 11,400 hospitals across 780 towns as of 1 April 2026 [1].

The no-claim bonus for Aurora Gold is 25% of the base sum insured per claim-free year, accumulating to a maximum of 100% [1][5]. If a claim is made, the bonus is not reduced; it only stops accumulating for that year [1].
No, you cannot claim for IVF treatment [1]. Infertility, assisted reproduction, and IVF are listed as permanent treatment-related exclusions [1].
On the Aurora Gold plan, the sub-limit for cataract surgery is ₹75,000 per eye [1].

If you are not satisfied with the Stage 1 outcome, you can escalate to Aurora's Grievance Redressal Officer [2]. If Aurora's final response is unsatisfactory (or if Aurora has not responded within 30 days of the original complaint), you may approach the Insurance Ombudsman for your region [1].

Across all plans, road ambulance is covered up to ₹5,000 per hospitalisation [1]. Additionally, under the Aurora Gold plan, air ambulance is covered up to ₹2,50,000 per policy year within India, subject to prior authorisation [5].

Yes, in-patient treatment for mental illness is covered on the same terms as physical illness, as required by the Mental Healthcare Act 2017 [1]. The standard 30-day initial waiting period applies, and no separate waiting period is required [1].

The free-look period is the window in which a new policy can be returned for a refund [3]. It allows a policyholder to cancel within 15 days of receiving the policy document, or within 30 days if the policy was sold through distance marketing [1][2]. Upon cancellation, the policyholder receives a refund of the premium less the proportionate risk premium for the period of cover, medical examination costs, and stamp duty [2].
You get 150 wellness points for completing an annual health check-up [1].

A day-care procedure is a procedure that requires less than 24 hours of hospitalisation due to technological advances, making it payable despite the general 24-hour admission requirement [3]. Out-patient treatment is not considered a day-care procedure [3].
For an emergency cashless admission, the hospital must notify Aurora within 24 hours of admission [1][5].
No, Aurora administers its own claims and does not use a TPA [1].
To qualify as a hospital, a facility must have at least 10 in-patient beds in towns with a population below 10 lakh, or at least 15 in-patient beds elsewhere [1].

No, everything will not be paid [1][5]. Under the Silver plan with a ₹5,00,000 sum insured, the room-rent limit is 2% of the sum insured, which equals ₹10,000 per day [1][2]. Because the room tariff of ₹15,000 per day exceeds this limit, proportionate deduction applies with an eligibility ratio of 0.667, reducing the payable amount across eligible claim heads [1][5].

Dependent parents can be added under the Silver plan (at an extra premium), Gold plan, and Platinum plan, but they are not permitted under the Bronze plan [1]. Adding a dependent parent changes the premium calculation, as the policy premium is determined by the age of the eldest member covered, which often results in a higher cost than purchasing an individual senior-citizen policy [4].

Your waiting period credit will carry over only up to the sum insured of your previous policy, including any accrued no-claim bonus [1][2]. Any increase or excess in the sum insured will be subject to fresh waiting periods on the incremental amount [1][2].

To continue health cover beyond 90 days, you must inform Aurora and add the newborn to your policy as a dependent within 90 days of birth, which guarantees coverage without medical underwriting [1]. Additionally, if you need to file a reimbursement claim for the hospitalisation, you must submit the claim within 30 days of discharge and any post-hospitalisation bills within 15 days of the end of the applicable post-hospitalisation period [3].

The out-patient benefit (OPD rider) is not available on the Bronze plan [1]. However, the provided sources do not mention physiotherapy specifically, so whether out-patient physiotherapy has any separate terms cannot be fully answered from the provided sources.
On the Aurora Silver plan, a claim reduces your accumulated no-claim bonus by 10 percentage points [1]. It does not reset your accumulated bonus to zero [1].
Under the Gold plan, the coverage limit for a caesarean section is ₹1,00,000 per delivery [1]. If the hospital bills ₹1,60,000, your out-of-pocket cost would be ₹60,000 [1].

Knee replacement is only covered immediately if it is required following an accidental injury [1][5]. If the knee joint replacement is for reasons other than an accident, it is subject to a 24-month waiting period [1][5].
Total discounts are capped at 30% of the base premium [1]. The wellness discount (up to 15% at renewal) is applied last, after the cap, and is the only discount that may exceed it [1][3][5].

Cashless access is not available at an excluded provider [2][3]. Your only option is to seek reimbursement, which requires pre-approval and is payable only if the admission was a genuine emergency and no alternative facility was reachable [1][3][5].

The deadline to respond to a query depends on the type of claim:

* For general reimbursement claims, you have 45 days from the date of the query to respond before Aurora closes the claim [2][5].
* For Aurora Motor Insurance claims, you have 30 days from the date of the query to respond [4].

A planned cashless admission must be notified at least 72 hours before admission [2][3]. However, the sources show a disagreement, as an archived source lists the deadline as 48 hours before admission [1].

Aurora settles or rejects a complete reimbursement claim within 15 working days of receiving the last required document [1][2]. If Aurora raises a query, the clock restarts once the queried document is provided [1]. Under archived 2024 rules, the settlement deadline was 30 days from the last document [3].
Aurora Gold has no co-payment at any age [1]. Aurora Silver also has no co-payment, provided the eldest insured member is below age 60 [2].

Across the four plans, pre-hospitalisation coverage is 30 days, 45 days, 60 days, and 90 days, respectively [1]. Post-hospitalisation coverage spans 60 days, 90 days, 120 days, and 180 days across the four plans [1].

You should buy the Gold plan, as it covers dependent parents-in-law and removes room-rent sub-limits [1][3]. While the Platinum plan also covers dependent parents-in-law [1], the provided sources do not contain information regarding its room-rent sub-limit terms.

Dental treatment and oral surgery are permanently excluded under all Aurora indemnity plans, unless necessitated by an accidental injury requiring hospitalisation [2][3]. Additionally, out-patient dental work is explicitly not covered by any plan [1].

The grace period is 30 days from the renewal due date for annual policies and 15 days for policies paid in instalments [1][5].
